rule: run_all.cmd launches P00..P09 sequentially. Earlier FAIL/UNRESOLVED statuses are inherited as evidence annotations only and never suppress a later phase.

Construct and qualify self-contained canonical closed-braid probes for the preregistered knot families and controls.

Build topology-specific reduced tangent-map/monodromy fingerprints and test circulation-reversal covariance across numerical controls.
Certify odd velocity and even quadratic-energy response under global circulation reversal on the canonical dynamic probes.
Test a three-component container with one straight +z core vortex through each ring centre, all with the same circulation sign, against an identity-braid unlink control.
Retain the earlier parity-odd background selector as a separate structural lane; no physical closure without independent dynamics-ready background evidence.
Attempt no electroweak-style closure unless independent charge-like, doublet and second-U1 operators exist.
Aggregate operator statuses without allowing isolated PASSes to imply an integrated particle taxonomy.
